corrections_after_external_review.was: No Arabic dementia speech corpus exists anywhere in the world.
corrections_after_external_review.now: Arabic AD speech datasets exist but are not publicly available: a Tunisian Arabic database (IEEE 2023, syllable/DDK task, Alzheimer Family Assistance centre) and an Arabic transcript dataset (IEEE 2024, linguistic and acoustic features). The defensible claim is: no PUBLICLY AVAILABLE Libyan Arabic connected-speech corpus for dementia screening has been published.

TRAINING_PRIOR = 0.4721 (measured: 491 impaired of 1040). The likelihood-ratio formula was already correct; only the constant was wrong. [SUPERSEDED 2026-08-21: recomputed on the locked 987-recording development set as 465/987 = 0.471125, which is the constant now in risk_adjustment.py -- results/reconstruction/training_prior.json.]

corrections_after_external_review.was: Story retelling beats the field-standard picture task.
corrections_after_external_review.now: Paired bootstrap on 290 shared participants: +0.069, 95% CI [-0.017, +0.157], p=0.122. State as observed in this cohort, NOT as proven superiority.

corrections_after_external_review.was: English-derived empirical ranges applied to Arabic sessions.
corrections_after_external_review.now: Arabic sessions report raw measurements with ranges marked not established; band forced to insufficient.

corrections_after_external_review.was: Material memorised in childhood survives Alzheimer's far longer.
corrections_after_external_review.now: Exploratory culturally-adapted elicitation task. General sparing of overlearned memory is established; its extension to Quranic recitation is not. Six confounders documented.

corrections_after_external_review.was: Corpora may be combined only when each contributes both classes.
corrections_after_external_review.now: Datasets where corpus is strongly associated with class should not be naively pooled; source effects must be quantified and controlled regardless of class balance.
